Title: Azure Kinect DK is now generally available in the United States and China

Body.Content:
Azure Kinect DK is a developer kit with advanced artificial intelligence (AI) sensors for building sophisticated computer vision and speech models. Designed for versatility, it combines a best-in-class depth sensor and spatial microphone array with a video camera and orientation sensor, along with multiple modes, options, and SDKs.

Learn more
